text: The player's animation must correctly reflect the direction of movement, with priority given to vertical over horizontal when both axes are non-zero.
rationale: Player.gd uses if-elif for velocity.x and velocity.y, so diagonal movement triggers only horizontal animation, causing incorrect sprite facing.

text: The player must never move outside the screen bounds defined by the viewport size.
rationale: Player.gd clamps position only when moving purely horizontally or vertically (velocity.x == 0 or velocity.y == 0), allowing diagonal movement to bypass clamping and go off-screen.

text: When the player is hit, they must become invisible and disable their collision shape on the same frame.
rationale: _on_Player_body_entered hides the player and defers collision shape disable, but if another mob hits in the same frame before deferral, double-hit or scoring issues may occur.

text: The score must increase by exactly 1 every second after the StartTimer times out and before game over.
rationale: ScoreTimer.timeout increments score by 1 and updates HUD; if timer is disrupted (e.g., paused or reset incorrectly), score drift can occur.

text: While the player is invisible (after being hit), they must not be able to collide with mobs or trigger hit signals.
rationale: CollisionShape2D is disabled via set_deferred, but if the hit signal is processed before deferral or if visibility and collision are not synchronized, ghost collisions may occur.

text: After a game over, pressing E must reset the score to 0 and restart mob and score timers.
rationale: new_game() resets score and starts timers, but if called mid-game or without stopping existing timers, score or mob spawns may behave incorrectly.

text: Mob instances must be removed from the scene when they exit the screen viewport.
rationale: Mob.gd uses _on_VisibilityNotifier2D_screen_exited to queue_free; if notifier fails or is disconnected, mobs accumulate and cause performance issues.

text: During the 'Get Ready' message display, the player must not be able to move or be hit by mobs.
rationale: Player starts hidden and collision shape disabled via start(), but if input is processed before show() or if mobs spawn early due to timer overlap, premature interaction can occur.
